Chapter 554: Chapter 8 Galaxy Master, Run Away Quickly! (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

“`

If it weren’t for the strongest few among special life forms uniting to establish the Star Alliance, and officially joining the warfare of the peak interstellar clans, it’s likely that by now, special life forms would have been domesticated by human civilization.

Special life forms are powerful individuals, difficult to reproduce, but it’s not impossible for them to do so.

Apart from those extremely rare ones that can’t form a clan, most special life forms still possess the ability to reproduce.

Lin Yuan wasn’t afraid of Mo Luo creating a million spatial layers; five years ago, his combat power was almost equal to a Ninth Rank Millionfold Realm, let alone now.

He just didn’t want to stir up any trouble.

...

…

Whoosh!

Lin Yuan took another path towards the core area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Several days later.

Lin Yuan’s brows slightly furrowed.

“Is there a human Evolver nearby?”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, and a black disc appeared in his palm.

Any life form entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm would be randomly assigned to the peripheral areas.

This was to eliminate the possibility of ‘grouping up’ right from the start.

However, after entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, thanks to the black disc issued to every human Evolver by human civilization, one could sense all human Evolvers within a certain area.

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, strong individuals from among the Starry Sky Races could enter, so human Evolvers naturally had to stick together, help each other, in order to strive for the greatest opportunities and treasures.

“Is that Xilan?”

Lin Yuan recognized the identity of this human Evolver.

Not long ago, Lin Yuan went to the Central Star Domain to soak in the Eternal Spring, and it was Xilan who received him.

And on Battlefield B0001, Lin Yuan went on a relentless killing spree against the Tianyu Clan’s Eighth Layer invincibles, with Xilan, the Ninth Rank Evolver, overseeing the battlefield at that time.

“Xilan… seems to be pursued…”

Based on the sensing from the black disc, Lin Yuan looked towards a direction from afar.

…

Within the layers of space.

A purple-haired Xilan was fleeing wildly.

“Human, hand over the treasure, and I will let this avatar of yours leave,” a massive figure behind her was in pursuit, “Otherwise, your avatar will die, and the treasure will still fall into my hands.”

Upon hearing this, Xilan didn’t respond but continued to flee swiftly.

“That opportunity site was clearly discovered by me first, are all you humans so shameless?” the massive figure was furiously enraged, “If you hand over the treasure now, I guarantee I’ll let you go.”

The massive figure’s anger was sky-high.

As a peak Ninth Rank Evolver of the Hundred-Thousand Heavy Realm, he had already created nine hundred thousand spatial layers, only a little short of the Millionfold Realm.

The massive figure originally found an imminent opportunity site and was guarding it nearby. To his surprise, the moment the site opened, Xilan darted in, grabbed the treasure, and ran.

“Catch me if you can,” Xilan retorted through telepathy.

Although she didn’t yet know the treasure’s uses, the celestial phenomenon when the opportunity site opened was no simple matter.

So, regardless of what the massive figure said, Xilan would not agree.

What a joke.

There’s no reason to return a treasure once it’s in one’s possession.

“But it’s also a problem,” Xilan thought to herself.

“If this chase continues, there might be unexpected complications.”

Xilan was slightly anxious internally.

With her speed, the possibility of the massive figure catching up was minimal.

But their chase would certainly attract the attention of other nearby strong beings.

At that time, if the strong beings of the clans hostile to human civilization appeared, she, Xilan, might really end up in trouble here.

While Xilan was pondering over a solution.

Her inner world’s black disc suddenly made a sound.

“Xilan, do you need help?”

“Galaxy Master nearby?” Xilan was slightly stunned, and immediately knew Lin Yuan’s identity through the black disc.

“Galaxy Master, you better run; the enemy is not someone you can deal with,” Xilan responded immediately through the black disc with a shade of concern in her voice.

“Not someone I can deal with…”

Lin Yuan went silent for a while, looking around.

“Where are you?”
